The '''Kooroo Sundial''' was an ancient artifact discovered in the [[Temple of Kooroo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. Resembling a sundial in shape, the metal artifact was engraved with intricate notations, symbols, and geometric designs. Originally found by [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] on Vaynai's [[Streysel Island]], the Kooroo Sundial eventually fell into the possession of the art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Gallo Memm]], who kept the artifact on display in his [[Memm's villa|villa]] on the same island.

==Description==
The Kooroo Sundial was an ancient artifact located on the<ref name="Gamer8" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Vaynai system/Legends|Vaynai system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. The item was made of metal and was disk-shaped, with the exception of a wedge-shaped piece that was cut out of the disk and propped along its radius, resembling the gnomon of a sundial. The disk was covered with intricately engraved notations, symbols, and geometric designs, which further strengthened the artifact's resemblance to a sundial.<ref name="Gamer8" />

==History==
[[File:TempleofKooroo-Gamer8.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Kooroo Sundial was discovered in the Temple of Kooroo on the planet Vaynai.]]
The Kooroo Sundial was discovered by the early [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] of Vaynai. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its discovery, the artifact was located on<ref name="Gamer8" /> [[Streysel Island]] of the [[Vaynai Archipelago]],<ref name="Island">{{GamerCite|8|Topside Infiltration}} states that the Kooroo Sundial was originally discovered in the [[Temple of Kooroo]] and also places the [[Shrine of Kooroo|temple]] on the grounds of [[Memm's estate|Gallo Memm's estate]], which "[[The Vaynai Archipelago]]" establishes to have been situated on [[Streysel Island]] of the [[Vaynai Archipelago]].</ref> specifically in the [[Temple of Kooroo]],<ref name="Gamer8" /> one of a number of [[Shrine of Kooroo|stone structures]] of mysterious origins found on several Outer Rim worlds.<ref name="Journal14">{{JournalCite|13|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>

The Kooroo Sundial eventually made its way into the private collection of [[Gallo Memm]], an eccentric<ref name="Gamer8" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="CSWE Memm">{{CSWECite|II|305|Memm, Gallo}}</ref> and art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] who owned the entire Streysel Island. Memm maintained an [[Memm's estate|estate]] on the island and kept the artifact in a gallery inside his [[Memm's villa|villa]] there. At some point,<ref name="Gamer8" /> a team of freelance [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]<ref name="CSWE Memm" /> attempted to [[Heist at Memm's villa|break into]] Memm's villa<ref name="Gamer8" /> and steal a valuable [[Fenelar armor]] suit from the collection<ref name="CSWE Memm" /> on display there. By that time, the estimated value of the Kooroo Sundial was 11,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Gamer8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kooroo Sundial was described in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Topside Infiltration]]," which was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in [[Star Wars Gamer 8|''Star Wars Gamer'' 8]]<ref name="Gamer8" /> on [[December 21]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011210.html|text=Yuuzhan Vong Invade ''Gamer'' #8}}</ref>

In "Topside Infiltration," the Kooroo Sundial is listed among several valuable items the player characters may be interested in stealing from Gallo Memm,<ref name="Gamer8" /> although the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' established that the team specifically intended to steal a suit of [[Fenelar]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="CSWE Memm" />&mdash;an artifact also described in the adventure<ref name="Gamer8" />&mdash;before they were captured by the guards of Memm's residence.<ref name="CSWE Memm" />
